column1: # No surface is public-stable. The only public-preview file is the core CSS
# entrypoint declared in exports.tsv; every other path is internal. The token
# stylesheets are internal files: the custom properties they declare are
# classified one by one in tokens.tsv, the theme default and hook are
# classified in theme.tsv, the classless base subjects are classified in
# base.tsv, the layout hooks are classified in layouts.tsv, and the primitive
# hooks and states are classified in primitives.tsv. Together they form the
# public hook vocabulary that docs/architecture/hooks.md states.
# Every tracked file in this repository is classified here exactly once.
# Duplicate paths, dot-segment aliases, a directory row that overlaps another
# row, and rows that resolve to the same file (for example through a symlink) are
# rejected so one source file cannot carry conflicting compatibility classes.
# Classification is a compatibility statement, not a claim that a path is a build
# Completeness is machine-enforced against Git's tracked-file set (`git ls-files`):
# ds-check fails if any tracked file is missing from this inventory, so ignored or
# generated filesystem entries do not need classification and tracked files cannot
# A third scan-exempt field opts only that exact file out of the private-reference
# content scan and must state why. Directory-wide exemptions are rejected.
# Exemptions exist only for files that must legitimately contain private-path
# literals: the checker's marker constants, one negative fixture, the repository
# descriptor's Git remote, and the deliberate provenance pointer.
